book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Banchi ba muh wu wuŋ
Juu chimi Bafalashii bɛ bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo ja Yɛlusalɛm bo to bo taashɛ mbebe Jiso le.
Bo ja bo yɛŋ booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso bamu jii mwɛɛ chiaaŋ yi yidɛ, fì le lɛ bo gɛ̀ baaŋ chiaaŋ chugɛ gɛ.
Bafalashii bɛ Bajuu bachii gɛ̀ bii gɛh nyu kinche ki woŋ wu bachiji baboo ba fweele le, lɛ gɛ taŋlo muh ji fiɛɛ njɛ wu chugɛ chiaaŋ yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bo to bo chuge gɛ.
Gɛ taŋlo muh kwɛɛ tɛ fɛ waaŋ wu ji fiɛɛ njɛ bo chugɛ chiaaŋ bɛ bikaa biboo sɛŋ gɛ. Bo ka bo gee mwɛɛ mu a kinche ki woŋ le wesee, gɛh njɛ ki ba chuge muŋkoo mo bibɛɛŋ mo sháaŋ.
Bafalashii bɛ bamii ba duunyi banchi bayu mo bo biih Jiso le lɛ, “Le nje la wù booŋ buŋ ba ŋgoo bii gɛ kinche ki woŋ ki bachiji besa ba fweele le gɛ? Le nje la wù bo jii mwɛɛ bɛ chiaaŋ yì yiide?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Yosaya wù muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ jɛme nchiɛɛŋ kune bɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ le bamii ba jɛme yeye, bɛŋ gee yeye. Bɛŋ gee gɛh nyu fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ saŋ, Nyo duu lɛ,
‘Bamii banɛ ŋgvuune mɛ gɛh fɛmu fɛmu, muntele muboo nyu je yì ndefe le fɛ mɛne.
Bo yuuse mɛ nyu achiji, nje bo jode mwɛɛ mù bamii kwaji, bo yɛyi lɛ le jɛ yaŋ.’
Le gɛh tɛ no bɛŋ chinɛ banchi ba Nyo le, bɛŋ gɛɛde nyu ba gɛle bamii.”

content: Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kɛme je yì chuule ki bɛŋ fâŋ banchi ba Nyo, wu lɛ bɛŋ bîi nyu bena le.
Musɛ gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Ŋgvuuŋ chijo bɛ bwoo.’ Wu ka wu du tɛ lɛ, ‘Nɛ muh naŋ lo chiji kɛnɛ bwee, ba yuuyɛ lo mwɛdɛ.’
Geenɛ, bɛŋ tu duu fiena lɛ, ‘Nɛ muh kɛme fiɛɛ fì taŋlo wu fih chiji kɛnɛ bwee yu, wu ja wu jɛmɛ chiji bɛ bwee le lɛ fiɛɛ fiyu le Kobaŋ’, fì le lɛ le wa fi Nyo,
tu bɛŋ baaŋ ka bɛɛŋ gɛ lɛ wu jo fiɛɛ fiyu wu fi chiji kɛnɛ bwee yu gɛ.
Bɛŋ gee noo, bɛŋ gee jɛ yi Nyo tuu fiɛɛ fì achiji nje kinche kena ki woŋ kì bɛŋ yɛyi bamii yu. Mwɛɛ mumu ka nyume tɛ yu wesee njɛ munɛ mù bɛŋ gee.”

content: Fiɛɛ fì taŋlo fi chɛŋe bɛ muh
Jiso ka wu tɛɛŋ bamii bo to, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ bachii bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû fiɛɛ fì njɛme, bɛŋ kɛɛ chuule.
Gɛ fiɛɛ nyu yu a kfuuŋ fì leese yi ye yi muh le fì yiisɛ wu gɛ, le fiɛɛ fì bude a wu shɛŋ fì taŋlo fi yiisɛ wu.
Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ wu yu.]”

content: Jiso chinɛ bamii bayu le, wu lee yeh, booŋ be ba ŋgoo biih wu le kune ŋgaŋ wuyu.
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bɛŋ tɛ kee mwɛɛ gɛ? Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ fiɛɛ fichii fì muh leese a wu mu gɛ taŋlo fi yiisɛ wu gɛ?
Fi le noo, nje fi lese fi ya fi gɛɛŋ nyu fɛ fitele fie le gɛ, fi boh nyu a shɛŋ, fi jiɛnyɛ fi bu lo.”

content: (No Jiso gɛ̀ jɛmɛ noo, fi mo fi nyu lɛ mwɛɛ munjile munchii yuude lo.)
Wu ka wu gɛɛŋ fwe wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Le fiɛɛ fì bude yi muh le, le fi fì yiise muh,
nje mwɛɛ mù mbefe mu muh gee jade nyu fɛ fitele fie le. Mwɛɛ njɛ baŋkwajɛ ba befe, ki muh jaŋ kinjaŋ, ki muh choŋ bvuchoŋ, ki muh yuuyɛ muh, ki muh jaŋ kwɛ muh kɛnɛ juma muh,
ki muh guumɛ mwɛɛ, ki muh gee bijo, ki muh lɛɛde kinlɛlɛ, ki muh gee nyiɛŋ, ki muh bɛɛne kindoŋ, ki muh chɛŋe bɛ maŋkuŋ ma bamii, ki muh chiaase ye mo ki muh yuunfe kiyuunfɛ.
Mwɛɛ mù mbefe munɛ munchii jade nyu fɛ fitele fì muh le, fɛ mu yiise mwɛdɛ.”

content: Fitele fì kwɛse wumu wù gɛ̀ bee muh wu kituŋ gɛ leesɛ yi Jiso le
Jiso gɛ̀ ja fo, wu gɛɛŋ kimbe ki bilaantɛŋ bì Taya bɛ Sidoŋ le. No wu gɛnɛ yo, wu lee yeh yimi le wu goone gɛ lɛ muh kɛɛ lɛ wu le yo gɛ. Geenɛ, bamii kɛɛ gɛh lo.
Kwɛse wumu gɛ̀ bee yo kiyo kì yiide nyu yi mwa ye wù kwɛse le. Kimimia no wu yu kune Jiso, wu mo wu to wu gwe bikaa bie le.
Kwɛse wuyu gɛ̀ bee muh wu Glek, gɛ wù gɛ̀ bee muh wu Bajuu gɛ. Ba gɛ̀ boyi wu Fonishia woŋ wù Silia le. No wu gwe noo, wu mo wu lɛgɛ Jiso lɛ wu bvusɛ nchɛndaa debele wuyu yi mwa ye le.
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Chinɛ bo ya bo nyaŋɛ booŋ, nje gɛ fi joŋe ki ba jo ŋgu yi booŋ ba noŋ bvú le gɛ.”

content: Kwɛse wuyu chvuu wu le lɛ, “Le nchiɛɛŋ chii. Geenɛ, sege booŋ jii mwɛɛ bvú to yi boonyi munchvuge mu gweeyi fɛkuu”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nje fiɛɛ fì wo chvuse finɛ, wo taŋlo wo gɛ̂ɛne fiuŋ, nchɛndaa debele wuyu le wu chinɛ wa mwa yo le.”

content: Kwɛse wuyu mo wu ja wu tuu jiŋ fɛ yeh le, wu doo wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛŋ mwa gime fɛnta nchɛndaa debele wuyu nyu wu bu wa.
Jiso fɛ kinchifɛ tu ki yuge mwɛɛ ki jɛme
Jiso ja kimbe kì Taya le, wu fe Sidoŋ wu ka wu fe kimbe ki Bilaantɛŋ bì Yuufe le, wu mo wu tu je fɛ Mamasi wù Galalee le.
Bamii bamu gɛ̀ ja bo to bɛ muh mu, wù nyu kinchifɛ wu kee gɛ njɛmɛ gɛ. Bo lɛgɛ Jiso lɛ wu gɛɛ chiaaŋ yi ye ye le, wu fɛ wu.
Jiso mo wu jo wu bɛ wu bu a kinchvu kɛɛ ntɛnɛɛ bo tu bo nyu lɛbolɛbo. Wu leesɛ nyi yi kwaaŋ a bintuŋ bi muh wuyu le, wu chuuyɛ nchwene wu kuŋ lɛmɛ chi muh wuyu le,
wu bijɛ we, wu shooŋ,
wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Ɛfata”,

content: fì le lɛ,

content.text: “Gwênyɛ!”

content: Bintuŋ bi muh wuyu mo bi gwenyɛ kimimia, lɛmɛ che yaafɛ, wu mo wu tu wu jɛme chuule.
Jiso mo wu chiisɛ lo bamii le lɛ keefɛ bo gê bo sɛ̂ɛŋ muh le gɛ. Geenɛ, no wu gɛ̀ chiisɛ, fi ka fi tu fi nyu gɛh noo, bo feeji bo gɛɛne bɛ fi fwe fwe.
Jwe mo wu yuŋ lo bamii baaŋ. Bo tu bo ghaade, bo duu lɛ, “Jiso kee ki wu gê mwɛɛ munchii chuule. Wu gee binchifɛ yuge mwɛɛ, binjumɛ jɛme.”

footnotes.text: Bo gɛ̀ kɛme ki bo chuge chiaaŋ chinɛ a je yì kinche kiboo ki woŋ goone le.
Baŋwa ba kege bamu le ba taa fo lɛ, “mo binta bì ba to ba yɛme yu fɛ bo jii mwɛɛ.”
Gɛ baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme kinchiŋ ki 16 kinɛ gɛ.
Jiso gɛ̀ shoonɛ nɛ wu koode nyu yii fɛ muh wuyu le.
